fomod.Name: More Stress Gone
fomod.Author: Rusted-1
fomod.Description: Patches that let more things from other mods lower your stress in Stress and Fear. Glad You're Here: hugging someone lowers your stress by 5 (followers, strangers, pets), 10 (good friends), 18 (spouse or lover) or 25 (your children). OStim (1.1.0): climaxing in a scene lowers it by 5 to 20 depending on the act, with partner and Fertility Mode Reloaded conception bonuses.
